Nag courtesy call kay Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) Chairman Atty. Don Artes at General Manager Usec. Nicolas Torre III  ang ilan sa mga opisyal ng motorcycle ride-hailing app na Grab at Move It bilang bahagi ng patuloy na pagpapalakas ng ugnayan ng ahensiya at pribadong sektor. 

Layunin ng pagpupulong na mapanatili ang maayos na koordinasyon at bukas na komunikasyon sa mga isyung may kinalaman sa transportasyon at road safety sa Metro Manila.

Tinalakay ang mga inisyatibong naglalayong mapabuti ang kapakanan ng mga motorista, pasahero, at pedestrian. Ibinahagi rin ng bawat panig ang kanilang mga plano at best practices upang maiwasan ang aksidente at mapalakas ang disiplina sa kalsada.

Binigyang-diin ng MMDA ang kahalagahan ng suporta ng mga transport network companies tulad ng Grab at Move It sa pagpapatupad ng mga traffic rules and regulations. Ipinahayag naman ng Grab at Move It ang kanilang patuloy na pakikiisa sa mga programa ng MMDA para sa mas ligtas, maayos, at episyenteng sistema ng transportasyon para sa publiko.

#mmda #mmdaatyourservice

NEWS | Guwahati’s Chandmari flyover closed from January 30 until further notice, alternative routes announced

The Guwahati Traffic Police on January 29 issued a detailed traffic advisory announcing the complete restriction of vehicular movement on the existing Chandmari Flyover from January 30, 2026, citing ongoing construction work related to the GNB Road Flyover.

According to the advisory, the newly constructed GNB Flyover is set to merge with the existing Chandmari Flyover, necessitating a full closure of the latter in the interest of public safety and smoother execution of construction work. The restriction applies to all categories of vehicles until the completion of the project.

To manage traffic flow during the closure, authorities listed multiple alternative routes. Vehicles approaching from Zoo Road were advised to proceed via Apurba Sinha Path or Rajgarh Road, and then use South Sarania Road, G.S. Road, Dr B Baruah Road and GNB Road. Vehicles coming from the Chandmari side were directed towards Bamunimaidan via M.R.D. Road, with further diversions through Hatigarh Chariali via Railway Colony Road or the Noonmati–Mathgharia route.

@GhtyTrafficPol @DCKamrupMetro #Assam
